structures.name: Customer
structures.description: Identity and classification of debit card customers

public_attributes.name: CustomerID
public_attributes.description: Customer ID: unique identifier for the customer

public_attributes.name: Segment
public_attributes.description: Customer segment: SME=Small Business, LAM=Local, KAM=Key Account

structures.name: PermanentOrder
structures.description: Permanent payment order — bank_to, account_to, amount; belongs to an account; has independent lifecycle (creation → active → cancellation)

physical_entities.description: Permanent payment orders — bank_to, account_to, amount, k_symbol

structures.name: Income
structures.description: Funds received by the club — amount, source, date_received, and notes; received by members

structures.name: Loan
structures.description: Bank loan contract — amount, approval date, duration (months), monthly payments, status (A=active, B=finished, C=running, D=in debt); belongs to an account; has independent business lifecycle (approval → active → finished/default)

physical_entities.description: Loan contract table — amount, date, duration, payments, status

public_attributes.name: status
public_attributes.description: Loan status: A=active, B=finished, C=running, D=in debt

structures.name: Consumption
structures.description: Customer consumption records: monthly bills (yearmonth) + transaction details (transactions_1k) — Consumption, UnitPrice, Quantity

physical_entities.description: Gas station single transaction details — Price per item, Quantity, GasStation, Product

public_attributes.name: Customer
public_attributes.description: Customer ID: FK to customers table

public_attributes.name: Date
public_attributes.description: Date: in yearmonth table = year-month YYYYMM (201301 = January 2013); in transactions_1k table = calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (2013-01-13). Slash-form dates in questions (2012/8/24) mean calendar date

public_attributes.name: Consumption
public_attributes.description: Monthly spending amount (CZK): total customer spending in this month

public_attributes.name: Quantity
public_attributes.description: Quantity: number of items purchased in this transaction

public_attributes.name: GasStationID
public_attributes.description: Gas station ID: FK to gasstations table

public_attributes.name: ProductID
public_attributes.description: Product ID: FK to products table
